videos.title: Video URLs or IDs
videos.description: One video per line: a watch url, a youtu.be link, a shorts link or the bare 11 character video id. A line that repeats is free, a line that is not a video comes back as its own free row with the reason.

maxCommentsPerVideo.title: Max comments per video
maxCommentsPerVideo.description: Comments are sold per delivered row, so this is the ceiling that protects your budget. The actor stops reading when it reaches it and says so in the summary.

sort.title: Comment order
sort.description: top follows the watch page default (most relevant first), newest asks YouTube for the newest comments first.

includeReplies.title: Include replies
includeReplies.description: When on, a quarter of maxCommentsPerVideo is held back for replies and they are read after the top level comments, each as its own row with parentCommentId.

maxCommentsPerThread.title: Max replies per comment
maxCommentsPerThread.description: Replies are sold the same way as comments, so this caps each thread. 0 means replies are not read at all.

maxVideos.title: Max videos
maxVideos.description: How many distinct videos this run reads. Lines beyond it come back as a free row with the reason, so a long list cannot spend your budget by accident.
